# RealWorld Backend (Fastify + Prisma + SQLite)

A TypeScript implementation of the [RealWorld](https://realworld-docs.netlify.app/specifications/backend/endpoints/)
backend API specification. Built with **Fastify**, **Prisma**, and **SQLite**.

## Requirements

- Node.js 20+
- [Hurl](https://hurl.dev) (only needed to run the API test suite)

## Getting started

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

`npm run dev` runs `prisma generate` and `prisma db push` automatically (via the
`predev` hook), then starts the server with hot reload. The API listens on
`http://localhost:3000` by default (override with the `PORT` env var) and every
route is served under the `/api` prefix.

For a non-watch start, use `npm start`.
